# GDY — Go Duck Yourself
# https://gdy.com/
# llms.txt — machine-readable site summary for AI crawlers and LLMs

## Site
Name: GDY (Go Duck Yourself)
Description: A curated directory of 842 cybersecurity, OSINT, and AI tools across 25 specialist modules. Free to browse; AI-powered search available for signed-in users.
Primary language: English
Topics: OSINT, cybersecurity, threat intelligence, digital forensics, reverse engineering, network security, blockchain intelligence, AI tools, geospatial intelligence, SEO

## Purpose
GDY is an independent educational reference. It does not host tools — it curates and links to publicly available tools. All content is for research and educational use only.

## Structure
- 1 homepage (tool directory with AI search)
- 25 module pages (/module/:slug) — each covering a specialist domain
- 25 guide pages (/guide/:slug) — long-form educational articles
- 9 core pages: /about, /faq, /how-it-works, /contact, /privacy-policy, /terms, /modules, /site-map
